messages:
mohan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands thread 1: we need a single place to point customers and GTM for Optimize + Console onramp timelines. Can leads drop short, actionable dates/owners?

elaine: Short update: Hosted API Optimize (suggestions) GA target mid-May 2025. Dedicated preview in early May, GA in June after final perf tuning. Private deployments by request starting June; rollout to on-prem customers through July maintenance windows. I'll attach a lightweight migration checklist to the roadmap doc.

riley: For canaries, engineers asked for a recommended minimal set of knobs. Can we standardize a template they can copy?

elaine: Proposed default canary (we'll ship as Console template):
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  selectors:
    - org_tier: "beta"
    - path_regex: "^/v1/generate"
  fallback: "optimize-stable"
```
We'll add a wizard that pre-fills this and explains risks.

sam: Curious about perf impact numbers so sales can answer technical questions. Any ballpark for latency and cost delta?

elaine: Benchmarks so far: median token latency +7-12ms at seq=512; p95 +20-40ms under medium batching. Compute cost delta ~+3% on typical traffic patterns. Results vary with batch size and KV cache hit rates. We'll publish the perf deck + benchmark scripts next week.

anna: Migration policy: do routes on SDK v0.9 get auto-migrated? Need clarity for support and customers.

riley: No silent upgrades. We'll provide a one-click "migrate route" in Console that clones the route with the Optimize config and pins SDK version. Manual opt-in only. Also shipping a migration CLI script in devex.

mohan: Can we lock in owners and delivery dates for PM/sales to reference?

elaine: Owners & dates: elaine (product) - publish GA timeline + checklist by 2025-05-05; riley (devex) - Console template & migrate UI by 2025-04-28; sam (infra) - finalize perf tuning + publish benchmarks by 2025-05-02. I'll create roadmap tickets for these.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: console-template v3.2 -> 5% traffic (id: canary-2025-04-20-178765). Logs: https://deploys.internal/178765 

jen (ops): Note: Private appliance upgrades require a maintenance window for the agent update. Ops can coordinate windows starting week of 2025-06-02.

mohan: Thanks. @elaine please drop the checklist into the roadmap doc and tag me when done. :thumbsup:

riley: Ack. Will post the Console template PR and link here when it lands.

sam: Adding perf scripts to infra/benchmarks now; will ping when published.

anna: I'll draft a short customer FAQ for Support and Sales once the checklist is live.

mohan: Great, closing the loop  we'll surface owners on the roadmap board and update SRE/Support playbooks.
